e.title: IRDAI 印度保险市场数据
e.summary: 印度保险监管局（IRDAI）市场统计官方源：年报与行业数据——全球增长最快保险市场的保费/渗透度权威数据
e.body: IRDAI（Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India，irdai.gov.in）年报与 Annual Reports 页是印度保险市场统计的官方源：各财年寿险/非寿险保费收入、保单数量、保险密度/渗透度与行业结构数据（另有 GI Council 等行业机构年鉴）。对 RIAA：印度保险市场（全球增长最快之一）的官方数据入口——做新兴市场保险比较（印度保费规模/增速常为头条数据）与亚洲市场全集（HK/SG/TW/CN 已收）的补充；与 [[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]（监管框架）配套。
e.verified_note: web 核实：IRDAI 年报页（200）印度保险市场统计官方源；2026-09-17 复验：源链接 HTTP 存活（2026-09-17 实测 200）
e.title_hk: IRDAI 印度保險市場數據
e.summary_en: Official source of Indian insurance market statistics (IRDAI): annual reports and industry data — authoritative premiums/penetration data for one of the world's fastest-growing insurance markets
e.summary_hk: 印度保險監管局（IRDAI）市場統計官方源：年報與行業數據——全球增長最快保險市場的保費/滲透度權威數據
e.body_en: IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India, irdai.gov.in) annual reports and the Annual-Reports page are the official source of Indian insurance market statistics: fiscal-year life/non-life premium income, policy counts, insurance density/penetration and industry structure (with industry yearbooks such as the GI Council as supplements). For RIAA: the official data entry to the Indian insurance market (one of the world's fastest growing) — a complement to the Asia-major-market set (HK/SG/TW/CN already covered) for emerging-market insurance comparisons, paired with [[irdai-ai-governance]] and [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] (regulatory frameworks).
e.body_hk: IRDAI（Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India，irdai.gov.in）年報與 Annual Reports 頁是印度保險市場統計的官方源：各財年壽險/非壽險保費收入、保單數量、保險密度/滲透度與行業結構數據。對 RIAA：印度保險市場（全球增長最快之一）的官方數據入口——做新興市場保險比較與亞洲市場全集（HK/SG/TW/CN 已收）的補充；與 [[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]（監管框架）配套。
